title: The hard gate is deterministic and fully green before a merge
statement: The pre-merge hard gate MUST require type-check clean, lint clean on errors, a successful build, every assigned test passing, contract validation with byte-identical regeneration, and inventory regeneration without error, and a merge MUST be blocked while any member fails.
rationale: Article 17 makes the hard gate the deterministic component of the error signal and declares it non-negotiable.

strategy.rationale: A deterministic test corpus under tests/ and packages/*/tests observes this obligation; trace links the tests.
